open_ended_assessment: The eye sequence asks three different questions in a useful order: whether drift shares neural drive, what timing says about accumulation, and whether an integrator model can reproduce it. Central-source inference and precise integrator location are kept distinct. Independent vs shared variability, calibrated units and sampling limits are explicit.
